notes.title: New Release Date & Steam Next Fest Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
We’ve made a big decision: the demo for Fields of Fortune is being delayed one final time, now launching on October 13, 2025.

That’s right – we’re joining Steam Next Fest!
It’s the perfect chance to share our cozy farming game with more players, and to show you the best possible version of our demo. 💛

We know many of you were looking forward to July 15 – and we’re truly sorry for the extra wait.
But we believe this step will make the demo sharper, smoother and more visible.
[hr][/hr]Why the change?
🔹 Steam Next Fest brings more visibility & community reach
🔹 We’re using the time for polish and smarter automation systems
🔹 The new timing avoids overlap with major releases & the Summer Sale
[hr][/hr]🌱 What to expect:
– A cozy farming sim with true automation mechanics
– New fishing system, events & clever farm workflows
– Demo playable for the first time starting October 13, 2025

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/5b56da3f890bd4253b9ddb3012f73a2166b3b990.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you so much for your understanding, patience and support!
👉 Add Fields of Fortune to your wishlist so you don’t miss the Steam Next Fest demo drop!

We can’t wait to welcome you to the fields this October.

– The Fields of Fortune Team 🌾

notes.title: 🌾 Release Date Update – Fields of Fortune Demo 🌾
notes.content:
Hey everyone!We originally planned to release the Fields of Fortune demo on June 20th. However, with Mojang's major Minecraft update landing on June 17th, we’ve decided to give our cozy farming game a little more breathing room.

🎯 New Release Date: July 15th, 2025
By then, the big wave of AAA updates and the Steam Summer Sale will be over – and we believe that gives Fields of Fortune a much better chance to reach you without getting lost in the crowd.

We know delays aren’t fun, but we’re using this extra time to make the demo even smoother and more polished for you.


🎣 Bonus Sneak Peek: Fishing is in!
That’s right – we’ve just added fishing to the game! Here’s a little look at it in action:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/5b56da3f890bd4253b9ddb3012f73a2166b3b990.gif"]

Small cozy features like this are exactly what we’re focusing on in the final stretch – and fishing is only the beginning.

We're actively working on improving the system, and we’ve got a lot planned for it – from interactions to surprises and more depth overall. 🎏
So stay tuned – this little fishing rod still has big plans!



💚 Thank you so much for your patience and support! We can’t wait to welcome you to the fields soon.

👉 Wishlist now to get notified when the demo drops, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 📰 Demo Update: New Language, More Content & A Head Start into Automation!
notes.content:
🔧 The demo just got bigger – more content, new languages and a faster start into automation!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/7b7b3c30a5ce99cd7e409c2b87d3dcfdefbe4b04.png"]

Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve just pushed a big update to the demo – and it brings us one step closer to release.
✨ What’s new?
🌍 Now available in German & English
You can now play the demo in either English or German. Choose your language at launch and dive in!

📦 Expanded demo content
The demo no longer stops at the prologue – after that, you now get 30 minutes of unrestricted access to the main game. It’s a perfect chance to explore the gameplay systems and progression.

🎁 Starter pack for automation
Right after the prologue, you’ll receive a gift package with automation devices – so you can jump straight into building and optimizing!
[hr][/hr]
💬 Let us know what language you'd like to see next – and what features you’re most curious about.

🎯 The full demo release is just around the corner – wishlist the game and stay tuned for more updates!

Thanks so much for your support! 🙌
